A goat of Việt Nam (dê cỏ): a small goat, about 55 cm at the shoulder, brown with a light belly, small horns, ears to the sides, a short tail.
A goat of Việt Nam (dê cỏ): a small local goat, 50 to 60 cm at the shoulder, 25 to 40 kg. The template is a deer; the numbers of the shape are a guess from photos.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
